description:
Power BI Desktop is open on the Windows desktop. A CSV file named 'website_analytics.csv' is available at C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\PowerBITasks\website_analytics.csv. It contains 249 rows of web traffic data with columns: Source / Medium, Year, Month of the year, Users, New Users, Sessions, Bounce Rate, Pageviews, Avg. Session Duration, Conversion Rate (%), Transactions, Revenue, Quantity Sold.

Your task:
1. In Power BI Desktop, click 'Get Data' and import the file 'website_analytics.csv' from C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\PowerBITasks\.
2. After loading the data, create a Table visual showing the columns: Source / Medium, Pageviews, and Bounce Rate.
3. Add a Slicer visual for the 'Year' column to allow filtering the table by year (2019, 2020).
4. Save the report as 'analytics_report.pbix' on the Desktop (C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\).
